title: Many "try again" messages on these screens keep no note of why it failed
what: When a save fails on the exercise page (merge, records, hide), Add measures, editing or deleting a weigh-in, Edit profile, the import and its undo, the easy-week buttons, the month share picture, workout search or progress photos, the member sees "Please try again" but the app writes no line saying what went wrong. A failed import is the worst case: it may have removed the demo first.
expected: Every failure that shows "try again" also writes one log line with the reason, as the Start workout button already does.
how_often: rare: only when the phone database or file store fails
fix_line: Log the reason in every failure branch that shows a try-again message

title: A profile change that fails to save as you leave the page is lost without a word
what: Edit profile saves the name, bio and link a moment after typing, and again when you go back. If that last save fails, the error is written onto the page that is already closing, so the member never sees it and the change is simply gone.
expected: A save that fails on leaving is said on the next screen, or the page stays open until it is saved.
how_often: rare: a database write must fail at that moment
fix_line: Show a short message after leaving when the last save failed

title: After a reinstall, bringing progress photos back can fail with no word and no note
what: At start-up the app brings progress photos back from the backup folder and keeps the photo copies current. If that fails, the failure is thrown away: no message to the member and no log line. The gym look refresh and the widget redraw are dropped the same way.
expected: A failed photo bring-back writes a log line, and the Progress photos page says some photos could not be brought back.
fix_line: Log the reason and show a line on Progress photos when the bring-back fails

title: Find my gym says "No internet" when our server is only slow or down
what: When the number check or the gym search gets no answer within 15 seconds, or the connection to our server fails, the member is told "No internet. Connect and try again", even when their own internet works and the fault is ours.
expected: A different line when the phone is online but our server does not answer, such as "MettleUp is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes."
who: members using Find my gym (behind a switch)
fix_line: Tell no internet apart from no answer from the server

title: These screens count nothing, so first workout, import, join and day-30 numbers are unknown
what: The start-up, Workout tab, import, join-by-link and check-in screens send nothing about use. Only crash reports leave the phone. So MettleUp cannot see how many new members start a first workout, how many imports work, how many join a gym from a link, or who still trains after 30 days. Decisions on onboarding, import and the gym join flow are made blind.
expected: A small, private count of key steps (first open, first workout, import done, gym joined, still training at day 30), with no personal data.
fix_line: Add a few anonymous step counts sent to the existing crash report address
